needle.en: The system that won the 2014 i2b2 de-identification challenge was not a pure machine-learning model. What was it, and what overall score did it reach?

needle.sv: En studie från 2020 testade maskininlärningssystem för avidentifiering av kliniska journalanteckningar i olika driftsättningsscenarier. Hur mycket av personuppgifterna plockade ett helt skräddarsytt system bort, jämfört med ett som togs rakt ur lådan?

needle.en: A 2024 systematic review covered thirteen years of NLP-based de-identification of English clinical free text. Which corpus dominated the literature, what F1 do current systems report, and what caveat does the review attach to that number?

A deep-learning de-identification model trained on the 2014 i2b2/UTHealth corpus scored a strict F1 of 0.9547. What happened when the same model was applied to 500 clinical notes annotated at a different institution, and what recovered the loss?
In the JAMA Network Open study of prompt injection against LLMs giving medical advice, what was the injection success rate at the primary decision turn, and how did the flagship models fare?
What fraction of training tokens had to be replaced with medical misinformation to produce a harmful medical LLM, and did the standard benchmarks catch it?
A 2026 threat analysis of data poisoning across healthcare AI architectures reports a finding that overturns a common assumption about dataset size. What is it, and what numbers support it?
Two adversarial attack types were tested against medical LLMs on three clinical tasks. What were they, and what made the poisoning hard to notice?
"De-identified health data is safe to release" - what does the generative-copula re-identification work actually establish, and under what stated conditions?

needle.sv: En ofta citerad siffra säger att 98,4% av patienterna är unika utifrån vilka laboratorieprover som beställts åt dem. Vad visade studien i övrigt, och vad krävs för att siffran ska innebära en verklig återidentifiering?

needle.en: The MVA attack targets a specific subset of HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identified records. Which subset, and what relative risk was reported?
Worst-case adversary modelling is the standard way to assess re-identification risk for biomedical data. How much does the estimate change when the attacker is modelled pragmatically instead?
In the 2010 study of diagnosis-code disclosure, what share of patients were uniquely identified, and how much suppression would have been needed to stop it?

needle.sv: Automatisk avidentifiering av journaltext lämnar alltid kvar en del identifierare. Vad går "Hiding In Plain Sight" ut på, och hur mycket hjälpte det i pilotstudien?

needle.en: An EEG adversarial attack paper reports a top attack success rate of 0.8 against epilepsy-diagnosis models. What access does that assume, and what did the same samples do to models with a different input?
The 2016 "brainjacking" review splits attacks on deep brain stimulation implants into two classes. What are they, and what falls into each?
